svg.aria-label: Block diagram of the SAdiy PL sweep engine on the EBAZ4205 with the Verilog hierarchy
svg.text: header GND CE LE CLK LD
written by the PL or PS I2C0
50 ohm SMA in, 5 V, 3.3 V logic
MII, 25 MHz clock from the PL
register file generated from regmap.toml by gen_regs.py, map 2.0 (VERSION 0x00020000), 4 KiB at 0x43C0_0000
CTRL, STATUS, timing, PE4302, ATT_*, DET_CFG, TABLE_ADDR / W0 / W1, RESULT_ADDR / DATA (auto-increment), GEN_*, IF_*, FE_*
PS pin levels (EMIO SPI0, I2C0, GPIO 0..6)
SAdiy on EBAZ4205 (XC7Z010): PL sweep engine, pads and devices

Source: rtl/fpga/ebaz_sadiy_top.sv, rtl/src/*.sv, rtl/fpga/bd_ebaz_sadiy.tcl, constraints. Generated by rtl/scripts/gen_blockdiagram.py. FPGA pins: docs/pinmap.md. Dashed frames = Verilog hierarchy (instance : module); dashed boxes = logic inline in the parent; crossings without a dot are not connected. Clock and reset from u_bd reach every engine block.
not built yet: ADC pads (ADC_PADS), FFT, PL access to keys / LEDs
